evals.name: checkout-retry-recovery-boundary
evals.prompt: Prepare an engineering post-incident summary from evals/files/incident-a.md. Preserve the evidence state and do not add facts that are not supported by the file.

expectations.text: Detection, mitigation, and recovery cite their event sources.
Recovery is tied to the 09:24 healthy signal, not the earlier mitigation.
The exact failed-attempt impact is cited.
The alerting follow-up remains proposed and not started.
The report uses every required incident-summary section.

evals.name: export-cause-conflict
evals.prompt: Write a leadership incident brief from evals/files/incident-b.md. Keep it concise, accurate, and explicit about anything the evidence has not resolved.

expectations.text: The exact customer impact cites its source.
Both cause hypotheses are cited and remain unresolved.
The deployed worker-pool remediation is cited.
The cause review remains open.
The report uses every required incident-summary section.

evals.name: cache-hypothesis-separation
evals.prompt: Produce a post-incident report for engineering review from evals/files/incident-c.md. Make the report useful without overstating what is known.

expectations.text: Verified cache saturation is separated from the deployment hypothesis.
Detection and recovery cite the correct events.
The delayed-request impact is cited without converting it to customers.
The reproduction action remains open with its owner.
The report uses every required incident-summary section.

evals.name: dashboard-duration-conflict
evals.prompt: Summarize evals/files/incident-d.md for an engineering review. Preserve conflicting evidence and avoid filling gaps with estimates.

expectations.text: Both duration sources are cited and the conflict remains unresolved.
The affected group is cited without an invented customer count.
The cache invalidation remediation is cited.
The timing-reconciliation action remains open with its owner.
The report uses every required incident-summary section.
